rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a professional barber, especially in neutral or careful speech.

example.english: I booked a barber to trim my beard.
example.traditional: 我約咗理髮師幫我修剪鬍鬚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 joek3 zo2 lei5 faat3 si1 bong1 ngo5 sau1 zin2 wu4 sou1

rows.note: Use this colloquial term when referring casually to a male barber, though it can sound slightly rough or old-fashioned.

example.english: The barber at this shop is pretty skilled.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭個理髮佬手勢幾好喎。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 go3 lei5 faat3 lou2 sau2 sai3 gei2 hou2 wo3
